stem: Which of these models represent the same number?

options.label: F
options.text: Model X and Model Y, because 20 ones is equivalent to 20 tens.

options.label: G
options.text: Model X and Model Z, because 20 ones is equivalent to 2 hundreds.

options.label: H
options.text: Model Y and Model Z, because 20 tens is equivalent to 2 hundreds.

visual_elements: Model X: 20 small squares in 4 rows of 5 each
Model Y: 20 rods representing tens (each rod with 10 squares, 2 rods per row, 10 rows total)
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding place value and equivalency between ones, tens, and hundreds, including counting and comparing visual models.
